page.overview:
Who is Fightmaster?

Fightmaster is one of two minor characters in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. He is the twin brother of Dropkick.

He and his brother are members of the Rebellion, dedicated to their mission of stopping the king. They traveled to the past and convinced Invincible to overthrow the king's reign.

Fightmaster appears to be a moderately tanned human male with a muscular build. He has dark brown eyes and long hair of a similar color. Sideburns go down the sides of his face.

He wears a sleeveless yellow jacket over a fitted orange outfit with a white panel down the chest. His shorts are orange and reach just above the knees, and he has gray knee guards strapped over long white leggings. His gloves are beige with open fingers, and his shoes are orange with thick soles.
